settings.seeds_outdoor_rule: outdoor maps (AP and clients) averaged over 4 seeds when an exterior material has a normal-incidence slab loss > 30 dB, else 1 seed; floor planes 1 seed

tx_antenna.patch: tr38901 (8 dBi/65°/30 dB; other mount-specific patch parameters -> custom pattern with the same formula), polarization V, orientation (az, -tilt, 0) rad -> boresight = local +x

settings.rx: radio-map cells: polarisation-agnostic isotropic (|E|^2); PathSolver receivers: iso 'VH' summed
settings.client_maps: 8 clients traced as isotropic V sources onto the outdoor plane (reciprocity) for PL(X,c)
settings.geometry: walls = zero-thickness quads with ITU-R P.2040 single-slab materials (thickness = t); openings split out; slabs at rf.slab_planes; ground medium_dry_ground; context = 4 walls + roof

encoding: uint8: v = round((RSS_dBm + 130)·2) clipped to [1,255]; 0 = no signal (< −129.5 dBm)
tiers_encoding: uint8 per outdoor-grid cell (row-major like the maps): 0 = no attack, 1 = eavesdropping, 2 = deauthentication, 3 = evil twin (highest feasible tier, MODEL.md §6 with nested tiers evil twin ⊂ deauth ⊂ eavesdropping, equipment 'usb', Sionna PL for AP and clients; cells inside the footprint included)
